gaps.explanation: Schedule is 157,164 above the statement. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Total disbursements 665,472 (General column only; Bond column '-') and prints the Bond Fund 'Debt service (157,163)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), so the statement's disbursement total excludes it (JSON keeps it in other_financing, as printed). The Bond Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p9) prints it among DISBURSEMENTS: Debt service - principal 139,849 + Debt service - interest 17,134 + Other 180 = 157,163 (the three Bond Fund expenditure detail lines). The remaining 1 is printed rounding: the General Fund combining schedule (p11) lines add to 665,473 vs its printed total 665,472 (already in report_discrepancies). 665,472 + 157,163 + 1 = 822,636 = schedule total. Both are as printed; no fix.

Schedule is 2,110 short. The proprietary funds statement (p6, accrual) prints Utility sales 400,098 + Interest income 836 = 400,934. The proprietary funds budget-and-actual schedule (p10) is on the budgetary (cash) basis, column headed 'Actual (Budgetary Basis)': Utility sales 397,988 + Interest income 836 = Total receipts 398,824. 400,098 - 397,988 = 2,110 = gap (accrual vs cash collections). No fix.

Schedule is 16,230 short. The proprietary funds statement (p6, accrual) prints operating expense lines adding to 292,170 (printed total 292,169) incl. Depreciation and amortization 142,795, plus Interest expense 40,332 = 332,502. The budget-and-actual schedule (p10, 'Actual (Budgetary Basis)') prints Personnel expenses 78,538 + Operating expenses 81,470 + Debt service 156,264 = 316,272 (no depreciation; debt service as cash principal and interest; its 'Transfers to other funds (156,264)' is recorded as transfers). 332,502 - 316,272 = 16,230. Different bases; no fix.
